zh: 成年人最扎心的真相是什么
en: What is the most painful truth of adulthood?

zh: 没人会毫不保留的教你
en: No one will teach you without holding something back.

zh: 职场里前辈教你三分留你七分
en: At work, seniors teach you three parts and keep seven back,
afraid you will surpass or replace them.

zh: 行业里老手藏着核心干货
en: Industry veterans keep the core know-how to themselves.
There are always more tactics than honest answers.
You pay for courses or seek a mentor,

zh: 大部分人也是选择性的教学
en: but most people still teach selectively.

zh: 只是教你皮毛不会教你底层
en: They only teach the surface, not the fundamentals.
Everyone fears you becoming stronger,
except AI.

zh: 只有AI是这个世界上唯一
en: Only AI is the one teacher in this world

zh: 毫不保留无限次数不带私心
en: that holds nothing back, has no limit and no selfish motives,
and takes no emotional toll.

zh: 今天直接把我经常用的八大AI训练方法
en: Today I will break down the eight AI training methods I use,
all of them, for you.

zh: 最后我会把全套的提示词分享给大家
en: At the end, I will share the complete set of prompts.
First: a realistic mistake simulator.
It does not just give you the right answer.

zh: 你把你的业务问题丢进去
en: Give it your business problem.
Ask AI to build a realistic scenario
and deliberately set traps.

zh: 你做方案写SOP做营销策划
en: You make plans, write SOPs or plan marketing.
If you make a mistake, AI does not correct you directly.

zh: 只是不断的引导你自己找漏洞
en: It keeps guiding you to find the gaps yourself.
It lets you fall into at least two traps
before revealing where the problem lies.

zh: 反复练习直到你独立答对
en: Practice repeatedly until you get it right on your own.

zh: 不是背答案是练判断力
en: It is not memorizing answers; it is training judgment.
Second: a confusion breaker.

zh: 遇到难懂的专业知识点
en: When you encounter a difficult specialist concept,
do not let AI throw jargon at you.

zh: 要求AI先用生活类比给一句核心的钥匙句
en: Ask for a key sentence using an everyday analogy first.
Then it gives you three test questions.

zh: 必须三道全部答对才能往下选
en: You must get all three right before choosing what comes next.
Avoid only half-understanding.
You may understand what you read but still cannot apply it.
Third: a customized learning path.

zh: 给AI输入你的目标现有基础
en: Give AI your goal and your current foundation,
and how much time you can invest each week.
AI produces a seven-day learning plan.
Set aside 45 minutes each day.
Make clear what you should do today,
what counts as completion,
and where the likely pitfalls are.

zh: 一旦跟不上立即动态调整计划
en: If you cannot keep up, adjust the plan immediately.

zh: 不是一套方案硬套所有人
en: Do not force one plan on everyone.
Fourth: a hidden-gap detector.

zh: 当你觉得自己已经学会这项技能
en: When you feel you have learned a skill,
give it to AI.

zh: AI抛出五个深挖底层的问题
en: AI asks five probing questions
targeting blind spots where

zh: 看着会一上手就废的盲区
en: you seem to know it, but cannot apply it.
If your answer stays on the surface,

zh: 直接点破你的知识短板
en: it points out gaps in your knowledge

zh: 告诉你哪里只是浅尝辄止
en: and where you have only scratched the surface.
Fifth: a strict mirror of your progress.

zh: 把你每一次作业方案全部存档
en: Archive every assignment and plan.
AI compares your earlier and later work to distinguish
distinguishing real improvement

zh: 还是反复犯同一个老错误
en: from repeating the same old mistake.
If you stop moving forward,
it points that out.

zh: 只夸奖可以量化的进步
en: It only praises measurable progress,
without false encouragement.
Sixth: a worst-case scenario coach.
Simulate a high-pressure unexpected situation,
without providing any reference material.
For example, a client changes requirements at the last minute,
or your plan is challenged on the spot.

zh: 让你现场输出结束之后
en: You respond on the spot. Afterwards,
AI reviews your weak points

zh: 告诉你要针对性的哪些地方
en: and tells you which areas to target.
Rehearse the risks in advance.
Seventh: a mental-shortcut checker.

zh: 你解决完一个业务问题
en: After you solve a business problem,

zh: 让AI回溯你的思考全过程
en: ask AI to trace your entire thinking process.
If you relied on guessing or templates,
or arrived at the result through rote memorization,
it sends it back for a rewrite.
You must explain clearly

zh: 每一步为什么这么判断
en: why you made each judgment.

zh: 逻辑通顺才算真正掌握
en: Only sound logic counts as real mastery.
No relying on luck.
Eighth: a reverse-teaching simulator.
Reverse the roles: let AI be a beginner student,
and you teach it the knowledge.
Whenever you use a technical term,
AI immediately asks follow-up questions,
asking for examples and plain-language explanations.
If your logic is wrong,
AI follows that mistaken reasoning
until it reaches an absurd result.

zh: 帮你发现自己理解的误区
en: It helps reveal the flaws in your understanding,

zh: 直到你能把事情讲明白
en: until you can explain things clearly.

zh: 最后呢也是适用所有学习方法的终极大招
en: Finally, the ultimate method that applies to all learning:

zh: 高手呢不会只用单一的一个AI工具
en: Experts do not use just one AI tool.
For the same business problem,
you can assign different roles to multiple AIs.
AI number one:
a mistake simulator that creates scenarios
and lets you try, fail and encounter pitfalls.
AI number two: a gap detector
that finds problems in the plan.
AI number three:
cross-check all the results
and compare different approaches.
Multiple AIs cross-check one another,
challenge one another,
and refine the work layer by layer,

zh: 最后筛选出来最优答案
en: finally selecting the best answer.

zh: 成年人呢最高级的自律
en: The highest form of adult self-discipline
is using AI that holds nothing back
to take skills others cannot learn or fully understand,
or cannot learn completely,

zh: 练成自己安身立命的硬实力
en: and turn them into solid skills you can rely on.

zh: 你拿到的永远是当下最适合你的最优答案
en: What you receive is always the best answer for you right now.

zh: 完整提示词呢我会放在评论区置顶
en: I will pin the complete prompts in the comments.
I am Chao, building an AI business in Lanzhou.
